title: Greenwashing in Malaysian Tourism
excerpt: Companies advertise "whispering boats" and eco-friendly experiences while running diesel engines. It's usually ignorance, not malice. But agents need to know how to spot genuine sustainability versus marketing spin.
content_markdown:
Companies advertise "whispering boats" and eco-friendly experiences while running diesel engines. It's usually ignorance, not malice.

But agents need to know how to spot genuine sustainability versus marketing spin — your reputation is on the line when you sell a 'green' experience that isn't.
